title: Custom Trucking Semi Truck Breaking Through Stone Wall Vintage Comforter
description:
Add a bold, personalized touch to your bedroom with this custom trucking-themed comforter set from Jeminise, designed specifically for truckers and truck enthusiasts.

Key Features

  • Personalized Design: Customize this bedding set with your own name or custom text for a truly unique look.
  • Factual Visual Motif: Features a striking digital illustration of a semi truck breaking through a stone wall on a cracked surface.
  • Premium Comfort: Made from 100% brushed polyester fabric with whole-piece microfiber filling to prevent clumping.
  • Versatile Options: Available as either a Duvet Cover (no filling) or a Comforter (with filling), with optional matching pillowcases.
  • Available Sizes: Offered in standard US Twin, Full, Queen, and King sizes to fit your bed perfectly.
  • Easy Care: Machine washable in cold water; tumble dry on low heat for quick, fluffy results.

Product Specifications

Brand Jeminise
Product Type Comforter
Material Polyester
Fabric Type Polyester
Color Old Vintage Trucker
Theme Trucker
Pattern Cartoon
Seasons All
Care Instructions Machine Wash
